CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS execution_target_schema_components (
    component_name TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    component_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (component_version > 0),
    checksum TEXT NOT NULL,
    applied_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
    application_version TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE internal_reverse_finalizations (
    source_operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    source_attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    closing_position_episode_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    opening_position_episode_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    closing_completed_at_ts INTEGER NOT NULL,
    closing_completed_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
    opening_started_at_ts INTEGER NOT NULL,
    opening_started_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
    commission_complete INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (commission_complete IN (0, 1)),
    finalized_at_ts INTEGER NOT NULL,
    finalized_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (source_operation_id) REFERENCES internal_broker_order_operations(operation_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (source_attempt_id) REFERENCES internal_broker_order_attempts(attempt_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (closing_position_episode_id) REFERENCES internal_position_episodes(position_episode_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (opening_position_episode_id) REFERENCES internal_position_episodes(position_episode_id)
)

CREATE TABLE internal_reverse_fill_allocations (
    reverse_allocation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    source_operation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    exec_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    sequence_no INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (sequence_no > 0),
    closing_position_episode_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    opening_position_episode_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    close_quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (close_quantity >= 0),
    open_quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (open_quantity >= 0),
    executed_at_ts INTEGER NOT NULL,
    executed_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
    commission_complete INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (commission_complete IN (0, 1)),
    payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (source_operation_id) REFERENCES internal_broker_order_operations(operation_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (source_attempt_id) REFERENCES internal_broker_order_attempts(attempt_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (closing_position_episode_id) REFERENCES internal_position_episodes(position_episode_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (opening_position_episode_id) REFERENCES internal_position_episodes(position_episode_id),
    UNIQUE (source_operation_id, exec_id),
    UNIQUE (source_operation_id, sequence_no),
    CHECK (close_quantity + open_quantity > 0)
)

CREATE VIEW public_reverse_finalizations_v1 AS
SELECT source_operation_id, source_attempt_id, closing_position_episode_id,
       opening_position_episode_id, closing_completed_at_utc,
       opening_started_at_utc, commission_complete, finalized_at_utc, payload_json
FROM internal_reverse_finalizations

CREATE VIEW public_reverse_fill_allocations_v1 AS
SELECT reverse_allocation_id, source_operation_id, source_attempt_id, exec_id,
       sequence_no, closing_position_episode_id, opening_position_episode_id,
       close_quantity, open_quantity, executed_at_utc, commission_complete,
       payload_json
FROM internal_reverse_fill_allocations
